segments.t: Out in the courtyard, the twelfth bell fades into the midday air over Chengdu. Hao stands beside the dark-blue suitcase while Qing and Chen wait near the lobby doorway. Listen first.
十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
三年等得太久了，小晴。两个冬天前我就该打电话给他。
别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
大门门铃响了。干脆有力的一下。
挺起肩膀，志豪先生。记住那三句简单的话——我去开门！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
'Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.'
再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
'Give it a few more minutes, Mr Zhihao. Midday city traffic is always slow.'
而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
'Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.'
看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
'Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.'
先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
'Do not sit down discouraged yet! Keep looking toward the street corner.'
三年等得太久了，小晴。两个冬天前我就该打电话给他。
'Three years was too long to wait, Qing. Two winters ago I should have phoned him.'
别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
'Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?'
一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
'A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!'
我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
'My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?'
高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
'Tall, dark grey coat, looking up at our inn sign right now!'
大门门铃响了。干脆有力的一下。
'There goes the gate bell. One firm, decisive ring.'
挺起肩膀，志豪先生。记住那三句简单的话——我去开门！
'Shoulders back, Mr Zhihao. Remember those three simple lines—I will open the gate!'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

At four minutes past noon, a tall man in a dark grey coat rings the courtyard bell. One final scene in Episode 5—back inside at the front desk, Manager Zhou opens that letter. See you next time.
